_about: Recurring Huntress CTF 2026 challenge FAMILIES, hand-built from Days 1-3 (writeups under challenges/Day NN/). kb.py match scores a new challenge against 'tells' and prints the recipe, saved solver and gotchas. PROGRESSION RULE: inside each lane every day EXTENDS the previous day (3 PowerShell files -> +9 JScript -> +9 Batch; ELF -> C++ ELF+PE -> managed .NET), so expect Day N+1 = Day N's family + one new layer: reuse the saved solver and work ONLY the new layer. Add lessons with: kb.py note <family_id> "one line".

families.name: Multi-field script-triage inventory (PowerShell / JScript / Batch fixtures)
families.asks: Statically triage inert script fixtures and answer ~3-160 per-field questions (scenario/role, MITRE technique id, adapter, campaign id, url, wallet, mutex, JScript function/invocation/property style, Batch expansion + control form). Time Trial / Mastery re-randomize the files per attempt (Mastery = 318 ids over two sets).
recipe: unzip with password infected (WinZip-AES: use 7z x -pinfected or pyzipper, stock unzip fails); never execute anything
PowerShell: each file holds a base64 literal -> decode -> JSON with keys a-h
JScript: run ONLY inspect_*() in node with eval replaced by JSON.parse and ActiveXObject/WScript blocked
Batch: concatenate the SET fragmentN lines (unescape ^| to |) or decode HUNTRESS-MATERIAL per HUNTRESS-CODEC; read steps= adapter= campaign_id= file_path=
role comes from the steps signature (relay-handoff is staged_chain, NOT relay); control + expansion come from the RECOVERY REGION (between :HUNTRESS_SEPARATOR_DONE and echo()
submit byte-derived fields as one batch, then probe enumerable fields with prober.py + families/script_inventory.values.json (<=12 threads)
alternatives: CyberChef From Base64 + JSON beautify for the PS1 blobs
node + vm module sandbox for JScript instead of cscript
gotchas: GM accumulates accepted fields inside an attempt but rejects a whole batch if ANY field is wrong: bank solids, probe the rest per field
24 parallel threads caused 429 false no-matches on Day 3; 12 is fine
timed windows are SECONDS: one automated run, one runner, never debug during a timed window
the single-solve per-slot labels do NOT carry over: control and expansion are per-attempt in timed modes
the GM lists no accepted_values for the Batch control/expansion fields; the question prose names the expansion forms

Day06 Bash layer: Material_/Codec_ in .sh, codecs re-randomize per retry; decode generically via challenges/_lib/decode_bash.py; Mastery has 2 deliveries (op=artifact&delivery=i); timed window ~7s so run retry+solver in ONE wsl call

Day07 Node/Python layer (cost us ~10 min before found): the SAME Material_<id>/Codec_<id> self-describing-codec pattern from Day06 Bash generalizes to .mjs (Node) AND several embedded-Python-packer-recovery formats (cxfreeze, pyarmor, pyinstaller onedir/onefile, py2exe, zipapp, wheel, pyc38). Codec_<id> is a literal pipe-delimited string NAMING its own decode steps (e.g. base64_chunks|reverse_bytes, escaped_octets|rolling_xor|<xorkey>); each fixture also defines load_/decode_/recover_/inspect_/plan_<id> functions implementing exactly that pipeline with safe transforms only (base64, byte-reverse, xor, hex-escape - confirmed no exec/network/file sinks). DO NOT hand-derive each codec: just RUN each fixture's own built-in recovery - HUNTRESS_INSPECT_ONLY=1 python3 <file>.py (Python) or HUNTRESS_INSPECT_ONLY=1 node <file>.mjs (JS/mjs) prints the decoded pipe-delimited key=value fields via inspect_<id>(); plan_<id>() also returns a semantic field mapping (adapter/operation/arch/url/path/service) where some fields (like adapter name) are hardcoded literals in source, not even encoded. Check PS1/VBS/CMD fixtures for the same env-var-gated inspect-branch convention before assuming it's Node/Python-only. role mapping also shifted this round: relay-handoff AND staged-handoff both grade as staged_chain (GM-confirmed Day07); 'relay' is reserved for the distinct 3-step decode_configuration,locate_interpreter,dispatch_next_stage signature.
